goal: RG-401: writes declare every field their blocks change; trace_projection covers only the components it anchors

components.summary: One research question: cross-route identities, copy drift, ablations, candidate comparison and one verdict for writers.
responsibilities: Load the research index and resolve source-library provenance through the native validator.
Detect copied-content drift and direct evidence or conclusion disagreements between native routes.
Apply declared anchor ablations in memory and name uncaught ones and their side effects.
Project the authoritative search stop and root wording license into one five-key verdict.
The verdict lists live hypotheses and is contested exactly when routes disagree.
Evidence, gap and search rows name the hypotheses they bear on.
Status reads one hypothesis back and compares candidate folders without writing models.
state: loaded research index, native models and optional source library
side_effects: Read indexed model/library files and write only an explicit status --output

flows.summary: Observe a frozen argument prediction bound to its baseline identity.
